questions.stem: A 68-year-old man presents with crushing central chest pain radiating to the left arm for 40 minutes. ECG shows ST elevation in leads II, III and aVF. Which coronary artery is most likely occluded?
options: Posterior descending artery branch of the LAD
questions.explanation: ST elevation in II, III, aVF is an inferior MI, usually from the right coronary artery.

questions.stem: Which drug class is first-line for symptomatic relief of heart failure congestion?
questions.explanation: Loop diuretics relieve congestion. ACE inhibitors and beta blockers improve prognosis but are not for symptom relief of fluid overload.
